print("[probe] chunk loaded")

local function reg(name)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        return script:RegisterServerSignalHandler(name, function(signalName, params)
            local n = 0
            if type(params) == 'table' then n = #params end
            print('[probe] >>> SIGNAL RECEIVED name=' .. tostring(signalName) .. ' paramCount=' .. tostring(n) .. ' p1=' .. tostring(params and params[1]))
        end)
    end)
    print('[probe] register [' .. name .. '] ok=' .. tostring(ok) .. ' ret=' .. tostring(err))
end

function OnStart()
    print('[probe] OnStart, script=' .. tostring(script))
    reg('测试')
    reg('进入关卡')
    reg('服务器事件')
end
